svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 85 x 88 mm from 1.6 mm FR4 perforated board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 3.2 mm holes for the standoffs: 15 and 75 mm from the edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nearest the far end, 6 and 82 mm from the socket-side edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The prototype supervisor is built from modules on this board (see

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the wiring picture): microcontroller board with two CAN controllers,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two CAN transceivers, 18 to 75 V in, 12 V out buck, coil switch,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: precharge switch, input conditioning for the speed, brake and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: e-stop B signals, and a USB socket for the fault log.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep all modules inside a 73 x 68 mm area in the middle so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: modules clear the lid by 10 mm and the four standoff screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M3 screws into 35 mm hex standoffs; the board sits over

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the controller with 10 mm of air between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: board flat; no solder tail longer than 2 mm underneath.
